readerCopy.body: One offer is presented as relief plan, moral cause, investment, and rescue all at once. Money and attention pour in while the boundaries stay loose enough for every group to hear the outcome it wants. Jupiter magnifies the promise, while Neptune makes it feel compassionate, visionary, and difficult to question. Under the conjunction, belief and expansion become part of the same appeal. The generosity may be real while disappointment grows around the many different results people believed were guaranteed.
